My only lower bound is 4, since nodes {8, 13, 18, 19, 21, 26} form a 6-clique, so at least one of them must be spilled, and the cheapest is node 13 (cost 4). I could not recolor to also keep node 20, so the cost is 5 rather than 4.

I colored the remaining graph greedily, starting from the 5-clique {8, 18, 19, 21, 26}, and fixed conflicts by recoloring. Putting node 20 back fails: its neighbors already use all five colors, and I found no recoloring that frees one.

**Check.** I checked every edge among the 32 kept nodes; no edge joins two nodes of the same color.
